message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel chart comparing experience-guided navigation results: grouped performance bars across two benchmarks and performance over training steps for several experience ratios, with a validation-performance inset.","description":"Panel (a) is a grouped bar chart with Performance (%) on a vertical axis from 0 to 60 and benchmark categories AppWorld and BFCL on the horizontal axis. The legend distinguishes Avg@4 without experience (light blue), Avg@4 with experience (blue), Best@4 without experience (light pink), and Best@4 with experience (dark pink). AppWorld bars are labeled 15.35, 20.32, 25.17, and 31.68, respectively; BFCL bars are labeled 32.83, 38.60, 52.20, and 59.13. In both benchmarks, the with-experience bar exceeds its without-experience counterpart for both measures. Red dashed comparison marks and labels show +4.97% and +6.51% for AppWorld and +5.77% and +6.93% for BFCL.\n\nPanel (b) is a multi-series line chart with Training Steps on the horizontal axis (0–80) and Avg@8 (%) on the vertical axis (10–70). The legend identifies Baseline (η=0.00), Navigating (η=0.25), Navigating (η=0.50), Navigating (η=0.75), and Navigating (η=1.00). All five lines generally rise as training steps increase. The η=0.50 series finishes highest, near 65; η=0.75 finishes near 59, η=0.25 near 56, η=1.00 near 53, and the baseline near 51. The baseline levels off toward the end, while η=0.50 rises strongly after 60 steps. A horizontal-bar inset titled “Validation performance w/ varying exp. ratios η” shows scores for η=0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, and 1.00: 16.23, 16.45, 19.30, 20.18, and 23.25, respectively. The inset scores increase with the experience ratio.
